Kansas Corporation Commission
                                 Commission Meeting
                            November 10, 2026 @ 10:00 am
                  KCC Offices, 1500 SW Arrowhead Rd., Topeka, Kansas

                                        MINUTES

The Commission convened the regularly scheduled open meeting of the Commission at 10:00 am
on November 10, 2026, at the Kansas Corporation Commission, 1500 SW Arrowhead Road,
Topeka, Kansas.

Present: Chairperson French, Commissioner Keen, Commissioner Kuether, Litigation Counsel
Ahsan Latif, and Transportation Division Director Mike Hoeme. The following were considered
by the Commission:
     1.   Consent Agenda: Commissioner Keen moved for approval of the Items on the
          Consent Agenda dated November 10, 2026. The Consent Agenda contains pages one
          through nine and is attached to the Minutes. Commissioner Kuether seconded the
          motion.
          The motion was approved.

     2.   Discussion Item(s)/Other:
             A. Public Hearing on Adoption of Regulation K.A.R. 82-4-20 as Permanent
                Regulation.

             Ahsan Latif, KCC Litigation Staff, provided a presentation to the Commissioners
             regarding the adoption of the regulation and a public hearing was held. There was
             one member of the public present; however, no comments were filed with the
             Commission. A roll call vote was performed with the following votes by the
             Commissioners: Andrew J. French – yes; Dwight D. Keen – yes; Annie Kuether
             – yes. The regulations will be submitted for filing with the proper authority. A
             copy of the documents are attached to the Minutes.




                                        Page 1 of 2
     There being no further matters before the Commission, Commissioner Kuether moved for
    adjournment of the Commission meeting. Commissioner Keen seconded the motion. The
    Commission adjourned the November 10, 2026, Commission Meeting at 10:11 am.




                                                              Andrew J. French, Chair




                                                              Dwight D. Keen, Commissioner

     Amendments Explained
      Update Kansas regulations to more recent
       versions of Federal Motor Carrier Safety
       Regulations (FMCSRs)
      Updates are necessary to maintain federal
       grants
      Major changes of these regulations is the
       adoption of updated versions of documents
       of federal regulations

11/10/2026                              Kansas Corporation Commission
                                                                                4




     Summary of Substantive Changes:
     82-4-20: “Transportation of hazardous materials by
     motor vehicles.”

      Adopts the federal hazardous materials
       transportation regulations that govern the safe
       commercial transport of hazardous materials by
       motor vehicles within Kansas.

      The proposed amendments updates the federal
       regulations adopted to the most recent available,
       which are dated October 1, 2025.

11/10/2026                                     Kansas Corporation Commission
                                                                        5




     Public Comment Portion
      Time limits for comments may be imposed to
       accommodate all participants
